The all-ticked panel now lives in the Settings window's Space tab (inspection mood, with the repair mood and Disconnect this Mac… at its foot).

open_notes: Copy status of token-garbled / token-wrong-powers: their lines appear only in the Failure classification table, which has no copy-ratified mark. The token screen's copy was ratified 2026-07-25, and N14 says “the wrong-powers line points back at” the create button. Marked draft to be safe; confirm whether leg 5 ratified them.

“Your space is ready — nothing to redo.” (re-entry after success) appears only in the unmarked failure table and in Region 5's inspection mood (D — N36). Marked draft. The table row says “all ✅”, but the plan glyph for done is ✓.

space-found's line (“Found your space — v.myshroom.workers.dev, 14 videos. This Mac is joined.”) differs from U10's ledger wording (“Found your space — 14 videos. This Mac is joined.”): N42 inserts the link name. N42 says it “gives U10's recovery line its place” but does not mark this an amendment (the spec header says amending rows say **amends** and name it), so it is not listed under amendments. Check at ratification.

space-found entry differs between prose and diagram. Prose: “when a pasted token's probes find a space already there”, rendered in the wiring row's nest with rows three to five ticking in order. The diagram draws it as wiring --> space_found.

space-storage-gone: Set it up fresh resumes “on choice (N42)”, but its destination is not drawn and the diagram has no outgoing edge from space_storage_gone. The button is bold in the repair table (line 652) and plain in the failure table (line 623).
name-changed has no outgoing edge in the diagram. The prose says only “re-probe on return” / “re-probed when the window regains focus”.

Things the diagram omits that the prose states: wizard-offline as a node (drawn only as a note, “can interpose at any step”); account-signing-up's relaunch → account; wiring's fallback to gate-email/gate-card; Reconnect here → token on an owner-class Mac without the token; Take me there again (no transition). The wizard-offline transitions on token, card, gate-email, gate-card, name and wiring were added from N18's “network drop, any step”. The spec does not list the steps, so tests should cover every step that makes a network call.

Return defaults inferred from Law 8 (the surface's one filled button), with no explicit statement in Region 2: I signed up (account-signing-up), Create token in Cloudflare (token and its failure faces), Use this account (token-pick-account), Add credit card (gate-card), Allow recording (done), Set it up fresh (space-storage-gone). Only I have one (“the filled default”, line 444) and Claim this name (“Enter equivalent”, line 538; Law 8 names it) are explicit. Law 8 itself comes from N38, which is autonomous and awaiting ratification. The spec does not say what Return does while token's paste field has focus.
token-other-account: the repair table names only the line. The Create token in Cloudflare button and the paste field are inherited from token's render, not restated for this face.

The diagram's idle_ready --> space_degraded edge starts at idle-ready, which is Region 3's state. Where the banner sits in the popover (priority 2 of the N38 banner order) is defined outside this range (line 771).

space-degraded as a state dates from 2026-07-20 (its heading: “state 2026-07-20; surface designed 2026-09-30 — N42”); only its banner surface, copy and the repair mood are N42. The inventory marks the whole row D — N42, so it is recorded as provisional.

Plan row renders outside the first screen are not quoted, apart from the outcome-bearing facts (“✓ Your link name — …”, “✓ A Cloudflare account — Bagrat's Account”). Rows behind you drop their parentheticals, but the exact strings are not given, so tests should not assert them verbatim.

Cross-region doors into token that this range does not define: welcome's “Have an invite link?” paste door (N30: a token → the wizard at token), and Settings Space's “Add a token here” for owner-class Macs without the token (Region 5, around line 1190). The inspection → repair-mood re-probe is described in Region 5 (line 1184).

Region 2 has no “Fat-marker status” notes and no “check at ratification” markers. Every N42 item here (token-pick-account, the v clash, space-found, the space-degraded surface + repair mood, token-other-account, space-storage-gone, name-changed, the redrafted token line, entry arrow 4) is autonomous and awaiting Bagrat's ratification.
The region heading says only “ratified 2026-07-20” (structure). Copy is ratified per subsection on 2026-07-25 (the plan, account, token, card, name, wiring, done).

scaffold_flags.flag: Extractor-assigned ids. These have no backticked scaffold name in the spec: name~v-clash, token~repair-mood and space-degraded~no-token-mac (faces); repair-mood (from the diagram node repair_mood); re-entry-as-settings (from the ### heading). Rename if the scaffold names them differently.
The wizard is a window, never a popover: it has to survive the browser round-trip. Dock icon shows only while a window is open.

No step counter. Every entry (first run, after a crash, a week later) re-probes in this order: token verify → gates → bucket → Worker → subdomain, and marks the plan from the answers. It never reprints a blank plan. All wiring calls are idempotent.
Box 1 ticks at proceed and is self-reported: the plan's one exception. On re-entry a valid stored token re-proves it. The gates are probed, never assumed.

Plan glyphs: → current (Frost) · ✓ done (green) · • still ahead. Nothing in the plan looks clickable, so no checkboxes. Parentheticals drop off rows that are behind you. At name, the current row sheds only its example.
Action buttons inside nested step content sit flush-left across the wizard.
Row six is per-Mac and rows 1-5 are per-space. A second Mac redoes only row six. The plan spans the whole onboarding.

token never auto-opens the browser. Create token in Cloudflare is the only browser trigger, for the first visit and every retry. It opens the pre-filled dash.cloudflare.com token page (name + Workers Scripts Write, Workers R2 Storage Write).

A paste validates the moment it lands; there is no Continue button. Pipeline order: shape/prefix check (pre-network; verify-endpoint routing by prefix) → verify endpoint → probe by use (one harmless call per permission, never by echo).
On pass, the token goes to ~/.shroom/ (mode 600) BEFORE wiring begins. Never argv, chat or logs.

Probe pass at paste-validate: write-class probe (403 8000077 → gate-email), R2-enabled probe (needs-payment → gate-card), subdomain GET (10007 → name). Gates surface email first, then card. Existing-R2 accounts tick the card row silently.
Gates auto-poll under a spinner. The spinner is the only progress surface: no refresh affordance, no polling dots.
gate-card: the card is entered on Cloudflare's own billing page (card or PayPal). shroom never sees payment data.
wiring keeps the same gate classifications as a fallback. A gate that closes between the card step and wiring routes the same way there.

name: claim is explicit only, never on a typing debounce. Claim this name is filled and Enter-equivalent, disabled until the local charset check passes. No availability pre-check: taken is discovered at claim. Uppercase lowercases silently. Out-of-set characters never land, and a hint appears then fades. Exact charset/length edges are scaffold-time facts. The subdomain is created by PUT under the same token.
The as-you-type charset guard is stateless: no transition happens (N18 nuance).
“v” clash: detected in the probe pass before the name is claimed. Wiring never touches the foreign v Worker. The label shroom is derived; this is not a state.

Wiring: about 6 REST calls. The bucket is private from birth (r2.dev never enabled) and the v Worker is the only read path. Places the Worker's narrow R2-scoped parent token as a Worker secret. Silently enrolls the owner as member #1. The ~40 s propagation wait rides the calm line. Ends with a silent self-check: derive the S3 keys, then write/read/delete one tiny object through the real path.
wiring has zero affordances: no cancel, no button, no stage narration. Closing the window mid-wire is safe; re-entry re-probes and resumes.
Copy never names internals: 10007, verify-by-prefix, empty-bindings echo, the propagation poll, key derivation.
Every failure row is a first-class state with its own render and transitions, rendered under the plan's current row.
space-degraded classification: any auth- or space-class failure on a publish or on the periodic self-check → the config popover banner under the amber dot.

Repair mood = the same machine. The plan is re-probed from scratch and the first broken row is current with Region 2's own state. No second repair UI. Re-wiring needs no extra confirmation: the click was the consent.
Start recording stays live while degraded. Takes wait and drain after the repair. The stop sequence opens the page when the page still answers (N40).
Members never see repair tooling. Their side of the same break is space-needs-owner (N34).
token-other-account must never build a second space by accident.
name-changed is re-probed when the window regains focus.
Relaunching during the signup trip re-enters at the virgin fork (account).

Typography: Region 2 copy uses straight ASCII apostrophes (') throughout (no ’; verified: 67 straight, 0 curly in lines 385-713). Ellipses are the single character …, dashes are em dashes —; the only curly quotes inside a said-line are the “v” in the v-clash row fact. Tests should match the spec's characters exactly.

Not in the heading: the autonomous-sitting additions N38, N39, N41 and N42 are designed 2026-09-30 and awaiting ratification, so they are provisional.)

The popover has one banner (ask) and one status line (fact). recording-off appears before Start. The monthly re-confirm moves to config. Return = Start / Resume.

Autonomous, awaiting ratification. The count is Restart's undo. The auto-pause family (mic-lost, camera-lost, mac-away, permission-lost) and disk-full-stop open their popover unasked without key focus. disk-low sits under Start. Device rules at config.

amendments.summary: Autonomous, awaiting ratification. A launch you did is a tray click, and shroom's own launches stay silent. quit-confirm applies while uploads drain. Nothing ends the app mid-take.

amendments.amends: extends ratified N20 (perm-screen, all-set row six)
amendments.summary: Autonomous, awaiting ratification. Adds 'Flipped it already?' [ Reopen shroom ] under perm-screen for a declined relaunch. Row six ticks with 'microphone off for now' when the mic was denied.
Permissions happen at the end of onboarding in the same window (mic inline → Settings switch → guided relaunch → priming). The first Record is pure, and the arm-time re-probe survives as a guard.

open_notes: Law 8's local exception is marked 'check it at ratification': single-action faces whose one filled button LEADS (the saved-take banners). In this region that means recovered-take's Get link before Discard…, and by extension disk-full-stop and screen permission-lost (lines 141-143).

Return on disk-full-stop / screen permission-lost: Law 8 makes the one filled action the Return default, and line 854 says only the missing key focus stops a stray Return from triggering Get link, so Get link is modeled as the Return default once focused. Law 8's 'never the Return default' applies to banners, and these are popovers. Confirm.
The camera usage string sits in the copy-ratified chapter table, but N20 enumerates only 'the mic usage string' as ratified. It is marked ratified here on the heading's authority; confirm.

The quiet hint 'allowed in System Settings' (denied mic at config) is a quoted fragment with no full rendered wording. It sits under the permissions subsection's 'copy ratified' heading, so it is marked ratified on that authority (consistent with the camera string), but N20 doesn't enumerate it; confirm, and pin the full wording.

The diagram draws the screen-permission edge as recording → disk_full_stop, but the table gives screen permission-lost its own line ('macOS switched off screen recording, so the recording stopped at 7:15 …'). It is modeled here as its own failure-state that behaves like disk-full-stop. If it is literally disk_full_stop, it would also inherit 'dismissed unanswered → recovered-take', which the table doesn't state for permission-lost.
Discard… from disk-full-stop and from screen permission-lost has no stated or drawn destination (presumably discard-confirm).

discard-confirm reached from recovered-take: only the line change and the clean delete are stated. The Back and Discard destinations and whether Restart instead appears are unstated, and the diagram draws Back → paused only.
The diagram draws idle_ready → recovered_take ('launch finds an interrupted take'), but recovered-take renders as a banner atop config, greeted by the next tray click.

Not drawn in the diagram, though stated in the tables: Reopen shroom → relaunching (N42); a cancelled Restart count → paused with the take intact (N39); right-click Quit → quit-confirm from idle-ready (N41); config → Library / Settings via the footer; recording-off and disk-low; crash mid-take → recovered-take; recording-off → perm-screen via the Settings window.
mac-away gives lines only for sleep and lock. Lines for lid closed and user switch are unstated, as are its actions (presumably the paused popover's).
Screen permission-lost's microphone half says '(Resume continues without sound)' unquoted. mic-lost's quoted equivalent is “Resume continues without sound.” It's unclear whether a line renders.
`relaunching` has no render or said-line in the region.
Click-away on the paused popover is unspecified. N38's keyboard bullet says only that Esc dismisses.
display-lost: N24 says 'the same popover with the context line', but the edge row lists only Resume (greyed) · Stop · Discard…. Whether Drop a marker and Restart remain is unstated.

quit-confirm reached by right-click Quit from idle-ready: the Back destination is unstated (the diagram draws config → quit_confirm → config). Esc / click-away on quit-confirm is also unstated beyond Law 9's 'Esc always means back'.
recovered-take says 'next launch is silent', but N41 / law 5 make a user-made launch a tray click. Presumably such a launch opens config with the banner. Check against N41's amendment of Region 1.

The config heading is copy ratified (N21), but the popover grammar (banner slot, status line, disk-low under Start, Return = Start) is N38/N39 and provisional. The status-line string 'Uploading — 40%. Your link already works.' matches ratified owner-page copy (N26), but is provisional in this placement. 'Fully live ✓' is gone from the popover as from the page (DEVIATIONS #46, #52): the upload line just goes when the last upload finishes. Since 2026-10-18 the owner page says “Finishing your video — the link already works, share it anytime.” instead (N65 (7)); the popover keeps its own line.
all-set says 'all six rows green', while N42 lets row six tick with 'microphone off for now'.
The member all-set variant (two doors, Close · Record now) lives in Region 6 (N30), not here.

The bubble is not a state in the inventory. It is included as the overlay the region defines (N22; the surfaces table, line 1720). 'discard-confirm (saved take)' and 'permission-lost (microphone)' are fixture ids for variants that the spec doesn't name separately.
Law 4: a Quit request while paused opens the paused popover (its no-Quit note), and is declined silently while recording.
No in-range 'Fat-marker status' notes or 'check at ratification' markers exist beyond Law 8's exception (cited from the Standing laws).

scaffold_flags.flag: Info.plist usage strings ARE said-lines: the mic and camera usage strings must ship verbatim in Info.plist.
Mic resolves fully before the screen step, so system dialogs never stack (POC §4).
perm-screen opens the exact System Settings pane. The grant takes effect only on the next launch, and resumption after relaunch is derived from probes with no stored step counter.
Reopen shroom (N42) needs a self-relaunch path that lands in `relaunching` / the permissions chapter.
perm-priming: an invisible warm-up of about 1 s that triggers Apple's second (~30-day) consent at setup (probe: dialog real on Tahoe, non-fatal).
Arm-time guard: grants are re-probed at every record arm and when config opens. The missing beat is replayed, and a missing screen grant surfaces as `recording-off` before Start.
Monthly re-confirm: config must know when Apple's periodic re-confirm is due and run perm-priming's warm-up then. The popover may close as the dialog takes focus.
The camera bubble: the un-excluded preview-window trick with zero compositing. Draggable, not resizable, never takes focus. Live from config's opening through the take.
Never auto-pick an iPhone (Continuity devices), for the microphone or the camera (POC §2).
Quality presets Normal (1080p) / 2K / 4K come from POC §2.

Device fallbacks: a click's display is the source unless a display was picked by hand for this take (N56); a gone last-used display falls back silently to the menu-bar display. Same-named displays are labeled by position and numbered only when position can't tell them apart. Camera as the source previews at config on the clicked display, and the count plays on that display.
Countdown scrim lifts the instant capture starts, so the count is never in the take. The countdown takes focus so Esc works without extra macOS permission.
Recording: click = instant pause, and the popover opens only after the pause is confirmed (POC §8). Right-click mid-take = left click.
Capture writes locally regardless of network. Upload is opportunistic in the background.
Markers: metadata-only at the pause point in v1, and hidden from the UI until the editor ships (B143).
Restart's undo: the old take is discarded only the instant the new capture begins. A cancelled count leaves it intact.
Discard deletes the local take AND any bytes already uploaded to the bucket: a clean delete, no tombstone.
Non-activating popovers: an unasked (auto-pause / auto-stop) popover never takes key focus.
Thresholds: disk-low (~20 minutes example), the Start-greys floor (~1 minute), and the disk-full-stop floor, each at each quality.
disk-full-stop finalizes at the floor, never by a surprise ENOSPC.
A screen grant only returns after a relaunch, so screen permission-lost mid-take must finalize rather than pause.
mac-away detection: sleep, lid closed, screen lock, and user switch pause at that instant. The popover opens at unlock or wake.
recovered-take relies on §5.5's valid-but-truncated file surviving a crash or forced shutdown. Interrupted takes surface oldest first and persist across launches.
quit-confirm: the upload queue is on disk and resumes at the next launch. A system shutdown never asks.
stopping: finalize measured at 102 ms.
Launch provenance: tell a user-made launch (treated as a tray click) from a login-item or update relaunch (silent).
Popover anchor fallback to the top-right when the status item is occluded (e.g. behind the notch); over a hidden menu bar, where the item rests (B161).
Tray faces have no scaffold-grade names in the spec. The fixture ids use the spec's words (plain, red dot, pause bars, amber dot, Frost dot), and the scaffold should pin real names.

open_notes: Law 8's deliberate local exception, marked “check it at ratification” in the spec: stopped-stranded's one filled button (Save to Movies) leads instead of sitting rightmost (lines 139-143).

The region text never says whether Return triggers a button in stopped-offline (Copy link) or stopped-stranded (Save to Movies). The fixture sets return_default=true for both, inferred from Law 8 (“One default per surface, and Return triggers it”). Confirm at ratification; if wrong, those tests flip.

Owner-mode by role (941-944) and the upload-line faces (946-949) are N40. These are treated as provisional where they carry copy.

stopped-stranded's reason line is “the matching banner's reason line (N34 / Region 2)”. The member-revoked and space-gone lines map to N34's banners (lines 1578 and 1580) and are in the fixture. For “an owner's space whose page is gone”, the spec doesn't say which Region 2 line applies — the space-degraded banner (line 640: “Your space needs you — new videos wait safely on this Mac.”) or the owner-class-without-token banner (lines 659-661) — so the fixture asserts no reason line for that case. Pin it.

Classification overlap: stopped-offline takes “anything that can't reach” the space's page (line 961), while stopped-stranded covers “an owner's space whose page is gone” (line 975). An online Mac whose space page is gone fails the reachability probe; the spec doesn't say which state wins.

Transitions the spec doesn't draw. There is no exit from waiting-space (back to uploading or fully-live once the space is fixed). stopped-stranded has no exits (the take waits in the Library as “Waiting for your space” until it drains, is saved, or is discarded, line 982-983), and its click-away and Esc behavior is unstated. stopped-offline's click-away destination state isn't named. removed is entered only from [*]: no live → removed or on-its-way → removed. fully-live has no outgoing transitions.

Line 1017 says a mistyped link lands in the stalled face, while line 1027 says an unknown id renders on-its-way without a title. The diagram draws on_its_way → on_its_way_stalled but nothing from the untitled face; presumably the untitled face inherits its parent's stall transition. Confirm.

Embed face: “the same on its way, unavailable and removed faces” (line 1032), but those lines aren't restated for the embed. Whether on-its-way-stalled applies to the embed isn't said, and neither is the embed mark's hover label.
on-its-way-stalled: whether the title stays isn't stated. on-its-way keeps the title, and unavailable keeps it “if known”.

Beat 6's ratified line “You're offline — your link is ready and safe to share. The video follows the moment you're back online.” (line 921) is superseded. Its meaning now lives in stopped-offline's new wording, so tests should not assert the old line on any surface.
Save to Movies after the click: the “Saved to Movies ✓” label and the quiet Discard… are specified only for the N34 banners (lines 1582-1586), not for the stopped-stranded popover.

Character fidelity: UX-STATEMACHINE.md uses straight ASCII apostrophes (') throughout, with zero U+2019 in the file (verified). The fixtures keep the file's characters, while em dashes (—), ellipses (…) and ✓ are kept as written.

The page's upload line is singular (“your link already works.”), while the config popover's status line (Region 3, line 777) is plural (“Waiting for connection — your links already work.”). This is probably deliberate, but it is a two-surface difference tests must respect.
No Fat-marker status notes sit inside Region 4: the region was closed by N27.

scaffold_flags.flag: Fixture ids that aren't backticked scaffold names in the spec: owner-page, uploading, waiting-conn, fully-live, on-its-way-stalled and unavailable are kebab-cased from the Region 4 mermaid's snake_case names, using the same mapping as stopped_offline ↔ `stopped-offline`. waiting-space, owner-page-member, on-its-way-untitled and embed-face are descriptive placeholders for faces the spec describes but never names. Pin the scaffold names.

One beat, two names: the Region 4 diagram draws it as `finalizing`, while Region 3 (line 863, bold-backticked) and the inventory name it `stopping` (finalize, measured 102 ms). The fixture uses `stopping`; the diagram node should be renamed to match.
The reachability probe at stop: a short probe of the space's page, capped well under a second so a live stop never waits on it. Anything that can't reach the page takes stopped-offline.

The member cookie: the stop opens `v.<name>.workers.dev/<id>?k=<one-time-key>`. The Worker validates k and sets a long-lived cookie that names the member (“likely HttpOnly” — verify). It then 302-redirects to the clean URL, so the key never rests in the address bar. Owner-mode is rendered server-side. The Worker checks the video's maker against the cookie, and owner-class sees all. The cookie bears metadata powers only (rename, mark toggle), never storage credentials.
No copy affordance ever emits a keyed URL. Copy link (page, popover, Library) always yields the clean link.
Thresholds to pin: the stall window for on-its-way-stalled, and the upload no-progress window.

The deferred-page window after an offline stop: the page opens by itself only within the hour and only while shroom is still running. Only the newest of several offline stops opens. It waits for any running take to end.

Media artifacts the pages depend on. Download appears only once the single-file MP4 exists (R11). A small teaser MP4 lets iMessage and Discord play inline. The player's first frame comes well under 1 s (R6.2), with custom controls.
The embed route is `…/<id>?embed=1`: player only, with a small mark and the same on-its-way, unavailable and removed faces.
Every page is `noindex` (P1). No passwords or expiry in v1. No captions surface, but the VTT-grade foundation stays as background machinery.
The schema carries a sender-name field from day one, with no name UI in v1 (U3).
The mark switch is one space-global metadata write, which the Worker reads at render. Rename is a metadata write, live worldwide on the next load (R4: strongly consistent; no redeploy).
Docs carry the one honest cache note on rename: chat apps keep their unfurl cards for a while — already-posted cards keep the old title, new shares pick up the new one (R4.2).
Unknown ids render on-its-way without a title, indistinguishable from a not-yet-described video (R10: a bogus id leaks nothing).
Tombstone check before every upload resume (N35), so another Mac's delete stops this Mac's upload. This affects removed and uploading.
The page's interface stays backwards-compatible across app versions (N37).

Check at ratification (Law 8, lines 141-143): member-welcome and join-switch-confirm put the filled action first, following the ratified welcome's order. This is a deliberate local exception to macOS's default-rightmost order. Law 8 also names the saved-take banners as leading with their one filled button; whether member-revoked/space-gone's Save to Movies is filled is not stated.

Return is unspecified in several places. On invite-born while a new link is on screen, Copy link is filled but the field-owned Return ≡ Invite (Law 8). Add another Mac's filled Copy link, join-already-here's lone Close, and the web page's Copy/Open shroom have no stated Return. N31 says the join failures read the same in the app as on the page (79, 1532-1534), so the in-app wording for an unknown code is ambiguous. The destination of Leave this space… in member-revoked/space-gone is not drawn (Settings → Space has a sheet of the same name, N36). Save to Movies' Discard… confirm is not drawn here (deleting is the Library's job, N35). Fixture conventions used here. Faces without a backticked name are named '<parent> · <the spec's face name>'. The diagram nodes member_done / member_all_set / permissions map to 'done · member' / 'all-set · member' / Region 3's chapter (perm-mic → perm-screen → relaunching → perm-priming). The page renders of join-expired/join-used are faces of the in-app states ('· page'), because the diagram has one node for each and N31 says they read the same. Copy variants that swap a single line are folded into their parent with a condition note: offline/unanswered, unknown code, own-Mac expired, You're in, own space, only token-holder, half-set-up, Law 4's mid-take greyed line, and Save three / Saved ✓. Markdown ** and backticks are stripped from said-lines, plan glyphs (→ • ✓) are kept as written, and the spec's apostrophes are straight (') throughout this region (verified: zero U+2019 in 1282-1663 and in the reused lines 590-605/715-725).

Cross-region edges drawn in Region 6's diagram whose source state lives elsewhere: idle-unprovisioned → member-welcome (tray click while the invite lives, 1497-1498, 1616); idle-unprovisioned tray click after the invite died → join-expired once, then the plain welcome on later clicks (1498-1499; an edge out of idle-unprovisioned, not out of join-expired); all-set's Invite someone → invite-born (N20, 68, 1605); the end of the permissions chapter → all-set · member (row two ticks, 1628); idle-ready → member-revoked / space-needs-owner / space-gone (1631-1633). The paste doors that land on member-welcome: the welcome's 'Have an invite link?' → field 'Paste your invite link' (a token → the wizard at token; anything else → 'That doesn't look like an invite link.', 334-341), and Settings → Space's 'Have an invite link? Paste it here.' (1200).

Lines restated in this region that belong to other regions: U10's final form (1597-1598) restates Region 2's space-found line “Found your space — v.myshroom.workers.dev, 14 videos. This Mac is joined.” (D, N42, line 588); U6 (1658-1659) restates the landing hero's point six “Your team just accepts an invite and records — no Cloudflare setup for them.” (ratified, N6, line 202).

Membership facts without a state of their own. When a member leaves, the owner sees their row simply go; their videos stay, with their label, in Everyone (1564-1565). Removed members' videos keep their label in the Library; removal and deletion are never bundled (1369-1371). If re-invited after removal, the new link re-joins the same space (not join-already-here) and waiting takes drain (1588-1589). A member never sees repair tooling (1590).

A member's second Mac is a second invite: a separate row and a separate library. Members have no Add another Mac in v1, which is named as a post-v1 candidate (1400-1401, 1733-1734). Owner-class Macs other than the token-holder can do everything except repair or re-wire the space (1405-1407).

Secrets and argv: Later stores the remembered invite under ~/.shroom, mode 600 (1496-1497). The join link rides argv/shell history once: one-time use, a 7-day TTL, and one hour for own-Mac links. The admin token never gets this exception (1465-1468, 1389-1392, Law 13).

Quiet-take law: invites and deep links wait while a take is open (Law 4, 116-120). A mid-take install goes to install-refused-midtake with the link still unused (1474). Joining another space is among the acts that never run mid-take; their buttons grey with “You can do this once your recording is finished.” (120-123).

N29's three leg-19 flags were resolved as recommended: the link is the code (one artifact, three doors; bare and https:// forms accepted everywhere a link is pasted, 1413-1420); the Terminal hand-hold stays (flag 2, 1444); the inviter's name uses the short form. The name comes from the Mac account in macOS's short, locale-aware form, used silently, with no field anywhere; a wrong name is a post-v1 fix (1351-1353).

Join page facts: it is served by the space's own Worker with no shroom.am dependency. Its title is the hero line (for the unfurl) and it is noindex (1424-1426). It shows no prices, no Cloudflare and no card (1443). The members surface's N5 line is said once, with nothing about prices (1348-1350).
No Fat-marker status notes appear in this region.

scaffold_flags.flag: Instant member cut-off = rotating the parent token (an admin operation). Whether the UI offers it is a scaffold flag. An instant member cut-off control is listed as deliberately absent from v1 (parent-token rotation UI, N3).

Per-recording credential minting at upload start, minted again near the end of its hour (N81). member-remove-confirm's “a video already on its way has up to an hour to finish” is true only if creds mint per recording and live an hour: the copy is bound to the mechanism.

Own-Mac invites: one hour, one-time, owner-class, labelled silently by the joining Mac's sharing name. Every owner Mac records as member #1 with its own device key, which is what Remove revokes. A Mac that holds the Cloudflare token mints from that token and can't be stopped by a device key (no Remove…; Disconnect, or delete the token in Cloudflare).

Deep link registration (shroom://join/…) at first launch. The browser's own “open shroom?” prompt is the only step it adds (N29). [ Open shroom ] on the join page is this deep link; the paste line is its fallback.

The member cookie: owner-mode keys on the member, not the space (N40). The Worker checks maker vs cookie, and owner-class sees all. A member's owner-mode on a page is the title only; the space-global mark switch belongs to owner-class Macs.

R10's index/layout work is v1-urgent. The index must be safe for many writers from day one: per-recording objects (rec/<id>/ + meta/<id>.json), no per-member prefix, no shared mutable index. Named consequence, not in the spec's flags list.

The deterministic status seam (engineering requirement, not in the spec's flags list): the app exposes setup, permission and join state as machine-readable status, like the POC's --prep JSON. The guided agent narrates state and never infers from screenshots.

landing.summary: shroom.am, a static page with one job: take a curious visitor to a pasted command, with no false notes. Two columns on a laptop (N59). Left: the shroom mark and wordmark, large; the headline on one line and its line under it; one thin price bar, 0 to 30 hours to scale, as wide as the headline, $0 for the first tenth and $1.50 a month at its end; then seven terms with green ticks. Right: one box, its top level with the wordmark's baseline and its bottom with the last term's: the hero, shroom recorded with shroom (“2 min”, shroom.am's own file, playing in place: a still of the editor after the take's cuts with a play button and the length, the video under it, no caption; N58, N61, N70), a small Setup walkthrough button under it that opens “How to set up and use shroom” over the page (N70), a cut, and Install under that (Terminal, Homebrew and Coding agent tabs, Terminal first; each command with [ Copy ]; Read it first; the system-requirements line). No header: the page's foot, at the bottom of the first screen under the left column, holds Send feedback, GitHub, Questions and limits, Privacy and Terms, then the visits line. On a phone it stacks, terms before the video and install last: the brand, the headline and its line, the bar (its labels short: “$0 / 3h video”, “$1.50 / 30h”), the terms, the box (the hero, Setup walkthrough, then install), the foot, its links wrapping.
landing.entry: A visitor arrives at shroom.am through one of three entry arrows. (1) Direct: HN, README or word of mouth; a cold visitor who needs the pitch. (2) The recipient loop: they watched a shroom video and clicked the player page's mark (Region 4; whether the mark exists = U3); a warm visitor who already saw the product work. (3) An agent fetching the BYO-agent skill (Region 6's overlay). Also reached by going back from the source view.

said.text:
# shroom installer
#
# You're reading exactly what will run — this address serves one file,
# and this is it. Four things, in order:
#
#   1. Download the shroom app for your Mac.
#   2. Check it against its published fingerprint — if anything is off,
#      nothing gets installed.
#   3. Place it in ~/Applications — no admin password, nothing outside
#      your home folder.
#   4. Open it.
#
# Run it again anytime — that's also the update: same four steps, newer
# shroom. If shroom is in the middle of a recording, the script stops
# and changes nothing.
#
# Run it with --uninstall to remove shroom from this Mac.
#
# Trouble, questions: https://github.com/bagrat/shroom/issues/new
# No GitHub? hi@shroom.am works too.
said.note: The ratified header comment block of the install script, verbatim with its line breaks and leading spaces. In the file it directly follows '#!/bin/sh'. Inline comments elsewhere aren't ratified copy. The --uninstall line is B135's (Bagrat, 2026-10-14, on the UninstallTerminal board).

installing.summary: The install script. Internally it runs the version probe (before fetch), then fetch, checksum verify, place in ~/Applications, launch, handoff. The user experiences it as one stream of about 5 s. The pasted one-liner keeps -fsSL and fetches only the tiny script. The app download inside the script shows curl's native progress bar (N10). The script always ends by opening the app (no quarantine ⇒ no prompt). No Gatekeeper, no admin password, nothing signing-shaped on the machine. The menu-bar handoff happens later, at all-set (N20).
installing.entry: The user runs `curl -fsSL https://shroom.am/install | sh` in Terminal: from the landing's install block, or as a re-run after a net drop, a checksum failure or a finished take.

first-launch.summary: The installer's launch presents shroom as a normal macOS app, with a dock icon and a centered welcome window: no hunting in the menu bar on day one. The tray mushroom appears from the first launch onward regardless. Standing rule: the dock icon shows iff a shroom window is open. When the last window closes, the app retreats to the tray and the dock icon goes away. Launches shroom does itself (the login item, the update relaunch) are silent and tray-only. A launch the user does opens the door, like a tray click (N41, designed 2026-09-30).

welcome.summary: The centered welcome window (U1 + U4). It says what shroom is and what it costs, names the two steps ahead, shows the pre-checked login box, and offers [ Set up my space ] [ Later ]. It is the same ratified window on first launch and on any later day, from idle-unprovisioned's tray click. Set up my space morphs this same window into the wizard: one continuous onboarding surface, never a second window. Closing it ≡ Later, so there is no trap. There is no invite line (B159, which replaces N30's door): an invite link pasted anywhere in the window (⌘V) goes to member-welcome, a Cloudflare token goes to the wizard at `token`, and anything else does nothing. Quiet at its foot, where the line was, is Uninstall shroom… (B160): a Mac with no space has no Settings, so the welcome is where it uninstalls.

config.summary: A same-themed custom popover under the tray (Loom-style). It is never a native menu and never a window, so the dock stays clear. Click-away or Esc dismisses it with nothing lost. It is pre-filled with last-used values and never skipped: a confirm, not a form. Rows run top to bottom, each a picker (an icon, the pick's name, a chevron; its label is the row's accessible name, DEVIATIONS #45): Record (one source picker: displays by human name first, then Camera only), the camera (every camera here, then Camera off — a camera turns the bubble on with it, Camera off turns it off; DEVIATIONS #43), Microphone (every microphone, then No mic), Quality, then Start recording (filled, full width) with a quiet line beneath. The footer holds four icons with tooltips: Send feedback, Library, Settings, Quit (N60). The grammar is N38's (provisional): a banner slot at the top for asks, a status line above the footer for facts, and disk-low under Start. When it opens, the grant probe runs (`recording-off`), and a due monthly re-confirm runs perm-priming's warm-up. The device rules are N39's (provisional): never auto-pick an iPhone (mic or camera); a click picks the display it came from as the source, over a remembered display but never over a hand pick in this take's Record picker or Camera only (N56); a gone last-used display falls back silently to the menu-bar display; same-named displays are labeled by position; Camera as the source previews here; with a camera picked for the bubble, picking another display moves the bubble there. If the camera is denied, the camera picker shows Camera off and Camera as the source greys Start. Since N44 both pickers start with System default: it follows macOS's default input and its preferred camera (never an iPhone by itself), and a take keeps the device it started with. The owner page's Edit in shroom, for a video this Mac can't edit (N69), opens it by itself under the mushroom — the app you were in keeps the keyboard — with one line in the status line's place, said once until the popover closes.
config.entry: Not mid-take, and the tray clicked in idle-ready (or a launch you did, or all-set's Record now, or a cancelled countdown, which returns here still armed). Popover banners stack one at a time, highest first: saved take (recovered-take / disk-full-stop), the space can't take videos (other regions), recording-off, update-ready (Region 5).

stopping.summary: The stop beat: the take is finalized (measured 102 ms) and the video's id exists, so its page exists (P9). Stop means published, with no publish prompt (§5.3). Three ways out: the owner page opens (the normal case), stopped-offline, or stopped-stranded. The two N40 exits are designed, not ratified. `stopping` is the scaffold-grade name (Region 3, line 863, and the inventory, line 1696); the Region 4 diagram draws the same beat as `finalizing`. A beat: finalize (measured 102 ms), then Region 4, the link moment.
stopping.entry: A deliberate Stop from the paused popover (Region 3 paused → stopping), or Get link on a saved take (recovered-take's banner, disk-full-stop), which runs the normal stop sequence from the saved file. Stop in `paused`, or Get link from `recovered-take`, `disk-full-stop` or screen `permission-lost`.

owner-page.summary: The real shareable page, opened in the browser at stop. It is never a preview or a processing screen. From top to bottom: the editable title field, which is the only chrome (no header, no wordmark, no name, per U3); the player (first frame, play, scrub bar, `0:00 / 4:32`, fullscreen); [ Copy link ] and [ Copy thumbnail ] beside it (N46), the page's copy doors, with the upload line and a thin bar beside it; then, bottom-right, the owner switch, “made with shroom”, and the mark. Download works only once the single-file MP4 exists, and it is second-class (R11). Every quiet icon beside the title is there from the page's first paint, in its place, greyed and doing nothing until it can work, and wakes where it stands, so the row never shifts (Bagrat, 2026-10-25). Only the editable title and the switch are owner-only. The address bar shows the clean link because the key died at the 302. The clipboard is never touched (N1). Rename at any time later is a metadata write, live worldwide on the next load (R4). It works from this page in owner-mode or from the Library. Owner-mode by role is N40 and still provisional: the cookie names a member, a member's own pages give them the title only, and owner-class browsers get full owner-mode on every page of the space. When the space names its videos (N66), an untitled video takes the name made from what was said; while the free day is used up, a line under the title says the name comes a little later; and the player gains the chapters and the Captions button the recipient sees, in place on a page left open as they come (N67). Edit in shroom (N69): the scissors, the last of the quiet icons beside the title, after Download, only on the owner page, greyed until the video is fully up (as Edit… in the Library); it opens the video in shroom's editor on this Mac.
owner-page.entry: Stop finalized and the space's page is reachable and can fill. The app opens `v.<name>.workers.dev/<id>?k=<one-time-key>`. The Worker validates k, sets a long-lived owner cookie that names the member, and 302-redirects to the clean URL. The page also opens later on any visit from a browser carrying a qualifying cookie (owner-mode persists per-browser, rendered server-side), when stopped-offline reconnects, and through the Library's Open page (the owner-keyed door, N35).

The picture is made in the background after each title save, and a video with none yet gets it made when its page opens.

The browser's own “Open shroom?” is the only step it adds; the Mac decides by its own state: the editor, or the popover's one line. Where shroom isn't on the Mac, the page says nothing (only a Mac running shroom makes a browser the owner's).

In a space that listens it stays after the upload while the take is heard (`hearing`); elsewhere it goes when the upload drains (`fully-live`). It replaced “Uploading — 40%. Your link already works.” on the page (Bagrat, 2026-10-18 (relayed by the orchestrator): one indicator on the owner page, from the upload until the voice cuts land, “Finishing” his pick of its first word). The config popover's status line keeps its own words (U9 / N21).

said.text: Finishing your video — the link already works, share it anytime.
said.note: Under the player, after a small spinner that turns while the take is finishing (Bagrat, 2026-10-18 (relayed by the orchestrator): a small spinner in front of the words, no bar); no percent. Bagrat, 2026-10-18 (relayed by the orchestrator): one indicator on the owner page, from the upload until the voice cuts land, “Finishing” his pick of its first word. The same line stays while the take is heard (hearing); a stalled upload's line (waiting-conn) keeps its spinner resting.

waiting-conn.summary: The owner page's upload line when the Mac dropped offline after the page opened. The face is in the ratified diagram (inventory: “waiting”, R — N26). Its wording is an N40 line variant, so the copy is provisional. Its spinner rests, dimmed, until the bytes move again (N65 (7), 2026-10-18).
waiting-conn.entry: The Mac went offline after the owner page opened, while the upload was still draining.

said.text: Waiting for connection — your link already works.
said.note: N40 line variant. The config popover's status-line counterpart (Region 3, line 777) reads “Waiting for connection — your links already work.”

waiting-space.summary: The owner page's upload line when the space still serves pages but can't take uploads yet. The page opens as usual and its upload line says so. The spec never gives this face a scaffold name: `waiting-space` is a descriptive placeholder.
waiting-space.entry: At stop, or later: the space still serves pages but can't take uploads yet (a dead token, storage switched off). Members see the named-owner variant.

said.text: Waiting for your space — your link already works.
Waiting for Bagrat's space — your link already works.

fully-live.summary: The owner page once the queue has drained and nothing more is being finished: the line goes. On a page that was open, it fades, spinner and all; in a space that listens it first stays while the take is heard (`hearing`). A page opened after shows no line. No “Ready ✓” since 2026-10-18 (Bagrat, 2026-10-18 (relayed by the orchestrator): one indicator on the owner page, from the upload until the voice cuts land, “Finishing” his pick of its first word: one line, nothing after it; B142's “Ready ✓” retired on the page). The config popover's status line just goes (DEVIATIONS #46, #52).
fully-live.entry: This video's upload queue has drained.

owner-page-member.summary: Owner-mode by role (N40): on a member's own pages, the member's owner-mode is the editable title only. The mark switch is space-global (U3), so it belongs to owner-class Macs. The member sees no switch. When the space can't take uploads, the member's upload line names the owner. The spec doesn't name this variant: `owner-page-member` is a descriptive placeholder.
owner-page-member.entry: The browser's owner cookie names a member who made this video and is not owner-class. The Worker checks the video's maker against the cookie.

said.text: Waiting for Bagrat's space — your link already works.

stopped-offline.summary: An offline Mac can't load the page, so the paused popover morphs in place: no window, no dock icon. It shows the link, a Copy link button, and the promise that the page opens by itself when the connection returns. Copy link is explicit (N1). Recipients meanwhile get on-its-way, without a title until the details arrive. When the connection returns, the owner page opens, keyed, exactly as a live stop would. If a take is running by then, it waits for that take to end (the quiet-take law, N41). It fires once, only for the latest stop, and only while it's still “now”: several offline stops open one page, the newest. The page opens by itself only if you're back within the hour and shroom is still running. Otherwise, including after a quit or restart, the Library row carries the link and a login launch stays silent. Click-away dismisses the popover, and the page still opens later.
stopped-offline.entry: During finalize, the short reachability probe of the space's page (capped well under a second) can't reach it. This also covers Get link while offline from a saved take's banner (recovered-take) or from disk-full-stop.

said.text: You're offline — it's already safe to share. The page opens by itself the moment you're back.

The link, shown in the popover (backticked in the spec). The name and the id vary.
Comes from Law 10 (line 147: copying is always a visible button that reads “Copied”). The region text doesn't restate it for this popover.

Owners also get [ Reconnect your space ]. The page never opens, because it could never fill. The take waits in the Library as “Waiting for your space” until it drains, is saved, or is discarded. Under Law 8, this single-action face's one filled button leads rather than sitting rightmost.

live.summary: The recipient's normal page: the owner page minus the owner's two controls. It shows the title as plain text, the minimal player (first frame well under 1 s per R6.2, custom controls), Copy link and Copy thumbnail (N46), Download (quiet and second-class, once the single-file MP4 exists), and the mark with its hover label. Nothing else: no comments, no sign-in, no name, no shroom account anywhere. Every page is `noindex`, with no passwords and no expiry; captions only where the owner turned naming on (N67). Unfurls follow R5 honesty. When the space names its videos (N66), the seek bar splits into the video’s chapters, named on hover and above the thumb on a touch, and a Captions button joins the player’s row (N67).

on-its-way-stalled.summary: The upload has made no progress for a while, for example because the sender's Mac is asleep or offline. The line changes and the bar rests. The page promises nothing it can't know, and a mistyped link lands here too, by design. The id comes from the diagram's `on_its_way_stalled`; the inventory writes it as “`on-its-way`, stalled”.

library.summary: The Library window, thin by design (§5.6), built for two jobs: re-share an old video and clean up. It is a list, newest first. Each row shows a small poster, the title, then date · length; in Everyone, other members' rows add their admin-private label (N28; removed members keep it). Copy link is always visible; Copy thumbnail sits under it in the row's menu (N46), and Edit… after Open page (N63). Open page and Delete… show on hover or selection. State words appear only when a video isn't live (no word means live). A recovered take pins to the top under the amber dot, mirroring N25's banner. The full macOS idiom applies: click a title to rename it, double-click to open, ⌘C copies, the Delete key deletes, right-click opens a menu, ⌘/⇧-click multi-selects. Mine · Everyone shows only on owner-class Macs once someone else has a video here, and Mine is the default. Search is local and instant, over titles only. The window opens on the local cache, and the bucket refresh (R10 delta sync) runs behind it, sliding new rows in, including videos from your other Macs. Footer: the count only, with no sizes or prices (P13 parked). Scope: members see their own videos, owner-class Macs see the whole space. If another Mac deletes a video while this Mac is uploading it, the tombstone check at resume stops the upload and this row turns to 'Removed from the space' with Save to Movies · Discard…. Mocked row shape: '<title> — Aug 21 · 4:32' (+ ' · Mher' in Everyone). A pinned row (N75) shows a small pin before its title; its menu says Unpin in place of Pin. While auto-cleanup has videos going, an amber line above the rows says how many and when, and each going row says so with a Pin; once a round has gone, a line says what went, with OK.
library.entry: A space exists, so config is reachable: idle-ready, not mid-take. The user clicks the Library (folder) icon in config's footer. One instance: clicking the icon again brings the open window forward. A window opened before a take stays open through it (N41's quiet-take law covers only what shroom would newly show). It is also restored at its derived state after an update relaunch if it was open when Update ran. The dock icon shows while it is open (Region 1 dock rule).

editor.summary: The editor (N63): a window of its own for each video (N73), titled “Edit — <the video's title>”. Top to bottom: the video, playing the edit (cuts skipped, held to the trim); the play button and the time, edited position / edited length, with “was <the recording's length>” once the edit changes it; on the right the hint and Undo · Redo; then the timeline: the ruler, where a click or the playhead's circle dragged seeks (Bagrat, 2026-10-25), and the whole recording's sound as a waveform with the playhead: two yellow ends that drag to trim, a drag across the sound that selects a part with Cut <its length> under it (one that reaches a yellow end moves that end there, a trim), every cut red and hatched (clicking one offers Put back <its length>), every suggestion not yet taken dashed amber (clicking one offers Cut <its length>, as a selection does); either edge of a cut or a suggestion drags to move it, the pointer ↔ over it, its length shown live under it and the picture at the edge as it goes, stopping at the next cut or suggestion, the trim's end, a tenth of a second from its other edge, or where a second would be all that's left, one step for Undo (B195 (g)), and every marker (N64) a flag at its time, its pole the continuation of its dashed line through the sound. The footer: the line that the link stays the same, Revert to original and Done. The waveform fills in once the sound is read; until then the timeline is empty and the ends wait. Every change can be undone, Put back and Revert included; the changes stay in the window until Done saves them. While an earlier edit's original is still kept, the time it has left sits by Revert to original; once it is gone, Revert to original only undoes what changed since the window opened. While one is open, no edit becomes a video behind it on this Mac: the upkeep, and on the Mac holding the token the cleanup sweep, wait until every editor window has closed (B199). The owner page's Edit in shroom (N69) opens it as Edit… does. Either, on a video whose window is open, brings that window forward as it is; on another video, a window of its own opens for it, in front, and every other window stays as it is (N73). Each window is its own: its steps, its Done, its final video and its questions never touch another's. ✕ with changes not saved asks before the window closes (N71).

Row six is live on every Mac. A revoked grant un-ticks it (“screen recording is off”), with Turn it back on → the permissions chapter at exactly the missing beat, in this window. A denied microphone ticks the row with the fact, plus a quiet Turn on the microphone that opens System Settings' Microphone pane (a denied mic never blocks). Mid-take both exits grey (law 4). update-ready.summary: U7 notify-then-apply. A newer release, checked quietly in the background, is downloaded and verified. config grows a slim banner — the lowest of the four banner kinds (N38) — and the tray shows the Frost dot. What's new opens the release notes in the browser, and Settings → General mirrors the row. The banner never shows mid-take (config is unreachable mid-take, so it simply waits). There is no nag: the dot and banner sit quietly until applied, and versions roll up so only the newest is offered. On a token-holding Mac, applying an update also refreshes the space's page code. The install script stays the manual update path forever.
update-ready.entry: The background check found a newer release. It runs at launch, every few hours, and when the popover opens fifteen minutes or more after the last check (B154), against the project's public releases (no shroom server). The release is downloaded and verified against the published fingerprint. A space exists (config exists — before that, no banner and no dot). This Mac's macOS supports the release. It shows in config only when no higher banner (saved take, space can't take videos, recording-off) is present.

A press saves at once and the player follows; a press that didn't save puts the row back as it was and says so on one line (OwnerPageCutRows). hearing.summary: While the take is heard and named (N65 (7), N66, N82): in a space that listens, once the upload has drained, the owner page's one line stays: the same words, its spinner turning, until the take's voice cuts are planned and its name is in (the full name with its chapters and captions, or the naming ended with none), then fades as they appear; or five minutes have passed since the take went live, by the page's own count. A strip whose cuts land first shows under the player, the line under it. While the name is on its way the empty title shows no field (N84): no border, a soft gradient sliding across the whole title, with a line where the title goes saying a click names it, shorter on a narrow window; the page doesn't open in the field. A click or the keyboard in it brings up the bordered box, the shimmer and the line gone, the date as its placeholder, ready for typing; the shimmer stops with the line under the player. It never speaks of cuts or names. Edit wakes on the title row as the upload drains, beside it (OwnerPageFinishing, OwnerPageFinishingEnds, PageAiPendingC, PageAiPendingWholeBox). Owner-mode as the title has it (N40); viewers never see it.
hearing.entry: The browser is in owner-mode for this video, the space listens (N66), the upload has drained, the take went live less than five minutes ago, its words don't wait for the next free day, and the Mac hasn't been through them yet or the space hasn't named it yet: the status says the voice cuts or the name are coming.

edges.trigger: Keep editing or Esc: the question goes, every change still there

edges.label: Keep editing
edges.trigger: Keep editing or Esc, when it asked after a save that didn't go through: back to that face, every change still there

edges.label: Discard
edges.trigger: Discard: the window closes; what wasn't saved is dropped, and the video stays as it was last saved

edges.label: Delete all…
edges.trigger: Delete all… under the suggestions

edges.label: Delete all six
edges.trigger: Delete all: every row leaves, one Undo line

edges.label: Cancel
edges.trigger: Cancel or Esc

edges.label: Review…
edges.trigger: Review… opens the Library on what's going

edges.label: Not now
edges.trigger: Not now: put away on this Mac until the list of what's going changes

edges.label: Delete videos nobody watches
edges.trigger: A choice that turns auto-cleanup on or shortens it while videos already qualify

rules.label: offline, then back where the facts stand
rules.says: wizard-offline interposes on any network-bound step and resumes where the facts stand.

rules.label: a call answering proves the network is back
rules.says: A wizard call that was out when the network dropped answers after all: the face re-derives from its answer.

rules.label: an unclassified failure, and back
rules.says: The one face for a failure nothing else classifies, from any wizard face, and back when an answer clears it or Try again.

rules.label: ✕ closes the window
rules.says: ✕ closes the window at any row — Later's twin: nothing is lost, and the next door re-derives it. ⌘Q with one of shroom's windows in front and no take open does the same: that window closes, and shroom stays in the menu bar (B145). The Dock's Quit, the popover's and the right-click menu's still quit.

rules.label: every paste meets the shape check, then verify
rules.says: Any new paste starts the token row over: the shape check first, then verify; the row's spinner while a paste is checked or saved (the Checking beat).

rules.label: the rows mark themselves from the facts
rules.says: An answer can tick several rows: the plan's rows mark themselves from the facts each answer brings (token → gates → bucket → page → name).

rules.label: the chapter's step follows the grants
rules.says: Row six's step is derived from the grants and the warm-up, never stored: a grant already given skips its step, one switched off steps back.

rules.label: Turn it back on
rules.says: Row six is live on every Mac: Turn it back on runs the chapter's screen step wherever recording-off shows.

rules.label: the Space tab re-probes every row
rules.says: Settings · Space re-probes every row on entry; the first broken row is current with Region 2's state beneath it, or every row ticks (the inspection).

rules.label: click-away or Esc closes it
rules.says: Any popover closes on click-away or Esc; nothing is lost, and the tray stands where the facts are.

rules.label: paused shows its cause
rules.says: The auto-pause faces are faces of paused, re-derived from the cause and the Mac's presence; the tray click on the pause bars opens the popover at its cause; a Mac away shows nothing until it's back.

rules.label: Quit with uploads draining asks first
rules.says: Quit shroom — the right-click menu or the popover's — while uploads drain asks first, over whatever idle popover stands. ⌘Q with a shroom window in front closes that window instead (B145).

rules.label: the take finalizes itself
rules.says: Mid-take — a paused or asking take too — the screen grant revoked or the disk at its floor finalizes the take: the stop beat, then its own popover.

rules.label: a stop's popover holds until dismissed or answered
rules.says: A stop's popover is the stop's own: it holds until dismissed or answered (back online, the page opened); the next door is config.

rules.label: the tray click is the door
rules.says: The tray click is the door: idle → config, or the setup window at the row the facts derive (a Mac whose chapter isn't done opens at row six).

rules.label: a relaunch re-derives where you were
rules.says: Every entry re-probes: a launch or a relaunch lands on derive(probes), never on a remembered step.

rules.label: Disconnect… or Leave…
rules.says: The Space tab's exit is there in every mood: Disconnect… (an owner-class Mac) or Leave… (a member) opens its sheet — from a banner's button too (a removed Mac, a member's).

rules.label: Back keeps the space
rules.says: Back, or Esc, closes the sheet; the Space tab re-probes where it was.

rules.label: Settings opens where it should
rules.says: The gear opens Settings on General the first time, then the tab last used; Reconnect your space and Add a token here open the Space tab, which re-probes and lands on the row the facts derive.

rules.label: the tabs
rules.says: Clicking a tab is an entry: General, Space (which re-probes, law 1) and Members (owner-class only).

rules.label: the settings link opens Settings at its spot
rules.says: The link the shroom command's recording refusal carries (`shroom://settings/agent`, N62) opens Settings on General with the switch “Let it start and stop recordings” in view and lit for a moment: from the tray at rest, over an idle popover (it closes, as a click away closes it), and from another tab. It flips nothing. A sheet open in Settings stays, and Settings comes forward as it stands. Mid-take it opens nothing (law 4), and a Mac with no space has no Settings (B160).

rules.label: an invite opens its window
rules.says: An invite that arrives — the deep link, a paste, the installer's file, or one remembered at the tray click — opens the invite window at the face peek's answer derives: the welcome, waiting, a dead link's line, already here, or the switch's question.

rules.label: a face comes and goes with its cause
rules.says: Faces are render properties of their state: a state and its faces, and one state's faces, re-derive into one another as their causes come and go.

rules.label: one banner at a time, the highest
rules.says: config's banner shows while its cause stands and clears by itself when it goes; a higher banner hides a lower one (one at a time).

rules.label: its video deleted, the editor closes
rules.says: Deleting a video an editor window holds — Delete… confirmed in the Library, or this Mac's delete landing — closes that window, and no other (N73): what its open asked for stops, a save on its way answers no one, and nothing is saved (B199). Another Mac's delete reaches it as a save the space turns down (editor-save-refused).

rules.label: Quit or Update saves an unsaved edit first
rules.says: Quit — the Dock's, the popover's, the right-click menu's or macOS's, and Quit anyway once uploads are asked about — and Update, while editor windows hold changes not saved yet, save them first, every window's (N73), without asking (Bagrat, 2026-10-19; only ✕ asks, N71), and bring those windows forward; a save already on its way is waited for. Once every one has landed the quit or the update goes on, without waiting for the final videos (an upkeep makes them later). A save that doesn't land holds it: shroom stays, and that window says why. A take begun meanwhile drops it (law 4) (B199).

notes.text: a launch you did is a click — N41 · D Opening shroom yourself — Spotlight, Finder, the Dock, a fresh install onto a Mac that still remembers its space — acts exactly as a tray click, in every state (mid-take: it's the pause). The update lane stays silent (N9). And the quiet-take law: while a take is open nothing new appears, and nothing that would end or move the app runs — Update, Disconnect, Leave, Quit grey out with “You can do this once your recording is finished.” Launches shroom does itself stay silent — the login item — except the update relaunch, which opens the popover to say how it went (B155). Also the rescue when a crowded menu bar hides the mushroom behind the notch; the popover then drops from the top-right.

charset guard — not a state (N18 nuance) “Lowercase letters, numbers, and dashes.” a stray character never lands — the line appears, then fades; uppercase lowercases silently. No transition happens, so this stays a guard.
Re-entry after success is Settings → Space (N36): the six ticked rows with their facts — “Your space is ready — nothing to redo.” — and Disconnect this Mac… at its foot. See Region 5.
A denied mic never blocks — silent screencasts are legitimate. config later shows the mic off with a quiet “allowed in System Settings” hint.
Camera is never asked at onboarding — it prompts inline at the first camera-mode pick. Don't ask for hardware the user may never use.
Arm-time guard, not a step: every record arm re-probes grants and replays exactly the missing beat. Docs carry Apple's ~monthly re-confirm honestly — their policy.

the popover's grammar — N38 · D Two slots, never more. The banner (top) is an ask — one at a time, highest first: a saved take · the space can't take videos · recording switched off · an update (Frost, slimmest). The status line (above the footer) is a fact — “Uploading — 40%. Your link already works.” · “Uploading two videos — 40%.” · “Waiting for connection — your links already work.” · “Updated to 1.3.0 ✓” once. Disk-low sits under Start. Return = Start recording.

devices at config — N39 · D Never auto-pick an iPhone — mic or camera. A last-used display that's gone falls back to the one with the menu bar. No microphone: “No microphone — your video will be silent.” Camera as the source previews at config, like the bubble. With a camera picked for the bubble, picking another display moves the bubble there. Same-named displays get their place: “LG UltraFine (left)” / “(right)”. Camera denied: the camera picker goes back to Camera off (DEVIATIONS #43), Camera-as-source greys Start — “Camera is off for shroom —” [ Open System Settings ]. The count is Restart's undo: the old take dies only when the new capture begins.

library faces empty: “No videos yet — click the mushroom in your menu bar to record your first.” · no match: “No titles match “502”.” · offline: “You're offline — showing what this Mac remembers. Renaming and deleting wait until you're back.” (Copy link stays live) · space unreachable (N34): the remembered list; only Copy link and Save to Movies live.

Space, other Macs Owner-class, no token: “✓ Your space — v.myshroom.workers.dev” · “✓ Letting macOS allow recording — on this Mac” · “Repairs happen where your Cloudflare token lives — on the Mac you set your space up on, or here if you add a fresh one.” [ Add a token here ] — Member: “✓ Bagrat's space — v.myshroom.workers.dev” · row six · “Your videos live there, where Bagrat can see them too.” · Leave this space… — the mark switch is owner-class only.
row faces — not states (N18 nuance) “invited just now” → “invited Aug 21 · 5 days left” → expired: the row offers New link — nothing is blocked, so no transition happens.

owner view — the owner's cookie rides along “This is the page Ani will see — opening it here doesn't use it up.” one quiet note on top of the same page — the owner who clicks their own link to check it never wonders if they spent it.

Save to Movies — the stranded-take rescue (N34) The take's single-file copy lands in ~/Movies under its title and Finder shows it. The take keeps waiting — it still uploads if the space returns — until discarded. Several: “Save three to Movies”. After saving, the banner reads “Saved to Movies ✓” with a quiet Discard…. No take is ever lost to a space that went away.

Late-arrival guard — not a state (N83): in the popover and in Settings, a pointer click on a control that something arriving by itself moved or put there in the last half-second does nothing; the next click works. What the person's own click or key changed, and the keyboard, are never held back.
